facts.activity_file: charging, tying in and guarding a blast

control_failures.control_label: receipt, magazining and reconciliation of explosives

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: trapped hazardous energy found after isolation of TH-3240

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EXPLOSIVES_RECONCILIATION: the receipt, magazining and reconciliation of explosives was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the receipt, magazining and reconciliation of explosives on TH-3240 and M-3240 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in charging and firing, specifically charging, tying in and guarding a blast. TH-3240 (tailings thickener) is in service for tailings thickening and decant. The task proceeded during a statutory inspection while the receipt, magazining and reconciliation of explosives was never verified as effective. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 27 March 2021 a potential incident was recorded on TH-3240 and M-3240 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a statutory inspection; chemical energy held as hydrocarbon was not released.
